subject: Migration 01 — verify export_shape visual loop
body: Use the REAL current Penpot file. Find or switch to the page named 'Migration 01 — 新西望'. Add one small temporary but visible text or rectangle labeled/identifiable as 'VISUAL LOOP CHECK' without disturbing existing content. Then call export_shape for the entire current page with PNG. The task is complete only if an actual PNG reaches the external qwen3-vl visual verifier and it returns PASS that the rendered page is visible/nonblank and contains the test object. Do not claim completion from API success alone. If direct MCP image content is absent, the local filePath fallback in penpot_agent.py must recover the PNG. Return the trace including image_count, visual_source, and visual_checks.
